_note: 3_02 'Bait' — fresh off Jealous Johnny: find Gord in the business district, taunt him into a rage, and lure him across town into the BMX warehouse where Johnny Vincent's greasers are waiting (recon: docs/re-notes/ch3/3_02-bait.md; the interior is imported/triggers/3_02_BMX.json — the second DAT, VERIFIED there). v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the baked 3-02 intro is a title card + speech beat; the provoke is a taunt SOCIAL (the insult-callback/hit OR-gate is npc_insult_event + ped_hit_event work — Gord is untargetable here so the hit branch is latent); Gord's 'chase' across town is our npc_follow (he trails the player at follow distance — lure_to_zone's hostile-chase version is pending; the 60 m watchdog is redundant with the follow (and leash-driving a follow target deadlocks the pair — caught in the smoke), so the pace fail is just the plain visible 120 s countdown — the recon flags the original's stop-not-restart asymmetry as OPEN, ours just burns); the bikes are gone (no vehicle bundle — the bike chase and the PedBikeBrawl brawl are foot versions, documented; bike_brawl_mode pending); the mission spawner of bike harassers is skipped (mission_spawner is a real subsystem, pending); the warehouse reveal is a letterbox speech beat (the skippable 4-camera NIS compresses); the brawl is three prep waves vs defender-Johnny + two greaser defenders (spawn_defender from wave D — their KOs fail, matching cbCriticalJohnny); the garage door prop choreography is the fade hop. The Gord-untouched outro variant: our town phase has no way to hit Gord, so the clean variant always plays — the $10 bonus pays via the in-mission reward (the variant check is ped_hit_event-pending). Pass: $20 + the BMX park unlock flag via the campaign on_pass (main.lua F_BMXGarage gating VERIFIED there); greasers +5 / preps -5 relative (omitted, set-only table). Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
title: Bait

stages.objective: Johnny wants Gord delivered to the bike park.

on_start.sub: The Vale. Gord's riding circles like he owns the place.

lines.speaker: JIMMY
lines.text: Johnny's plan: make Gord furious enough to chase me across town — right into the greasers' garage. Bait him, don't beat him.

stages.objective: Find Gord in the business district and taunt him.
stages.fail_text: Gord got knocked out — the bait's ruined.

on_complete.speaker: JIMMY
on_complete.text: Nice bike. Your girlfriend say you could have it?

on_complete.speaker: GORD
on_complete.text: WHAT did you say?! You're DEAD, Hopkins!

stages.objective: Lure Gord to the BMX park — don't lose him!

on_start.speaker: GORD
on_start.text: Come here, you little— GET BACK HERE!

lines.speaker: JOHNNY
lines.text: Well well. Gord. Thanks for dropping by.

stages.objective: The bike park belongs to the greasers.

lines.speaker: JOHNNY
lines.text: You led him here clean — never even laid a finger on him. Beautiful bait work, Hopkins.

lines.speaker: JOHNNY
lines.text: The park's ours now. And this — this is yours.
